balance_rationales.speed_rationale: Fast flying regional strike profile, below the fighter ceiling.
balance_rationales.target_rationale: Region pressure leads while monster damage remains conservative.
balance_rationales.rank_rationale: Damage and speed rise monotonically without increasing every field at every rank.
balance_rationales.non_replacement_rationale: Fighter remains faster and more monster-efficient at comparable ranks.

balance_rationales.speed_rationale: Slow ground movement pays for direct frontal assault strength.
balance_rationales.target_rationale: Balanced region and monster assault without any guard capability.
balance_rationales.rank_rationale: Power rises each rank while speed deliberately plateaus.
balance_rationales.non_replacement_rationale: Industry fighters retain a decisive mobility advantage.

balance_rationales.speed_rationale: Temporary launch deployment is the slowest physical profile.
balance_rationales.target_rationale: Monster assault specialization trades away region efficiency.
balance_rationales.rank_rationale: Monster power grows faster than region power; speed advances only at rank III.
balance_rationales.non_replacement_rationale: It never persists as a facility and cannot replace mobile dual-purpose forces.

balance_rationales.speed_rationale: Large flying force is slower than bombers but faster than heavy ground profiles.
balance_rationales.target_rationale: Dual-purpose heavy assault favors monster pressure over bomber speed.
balance_rationales.rank_rationale: Both attack curves grow monotonically with a measured speed increase.
balance_rationales.non_replacement_rationale: Bomber remains the faster region specialist and missile retains monster efficiency.
